# gtk4 codegen must produce compilable cgo. `sngl build` compiles the generated
# C/cgo to a binary without running it, so it needs no display. It compiles
# under -update and -verify, and plain verify answers it from its record, as
# it does every build a script makes: CI compiles nothing a record answers.

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
[!exec:pkg-config] skip 'pkg-config required'
[!exec:cc] skip 'C compiler required for cgo'
[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'

sngl build --platform=gtk4 --lang=go app.sngl -o out
[toolchain] exists out/app

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { go { gtk4 } }

component greeter node {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

window {
}
-- testrun/build/gtk4/go/app.sngl/1 --
sha256:751f1e2c90197f65a72800339a7da2bc
{}
